about: Penetanguishene is a town on a sheltered Georgian Bay harbour in Simcoe County, Ontario, beside Midland and the former Huronia mission country. A bilingual naval-and-military heritage, Discovery Harbour, and a working waterfront define the community. About 10,000 people live in Penetanguishene.
